question: At a lakeside ultrafiltration plant, permeate flow falls while feed pressure rises over two weeks. What pattern most strongly points to fouling rather than a pump fault?

A brief power dip recorded during the night shift
A change in the colour of the plant lighting

optionA: A steady rise in transmembrane pressure at similar flux

optionD: A change in the colour of the plant lighting

explanation: Land use controls in vulnerable areas prevent risky activities from being established where they could affect the wells.
options: Land use conditions that restrict risky activities in the area
A larger welcome sign at the subdivision entrance road
A one time newspaper notice after construction is finished
Lower water rates for homes built closest to the wells
sourceTitle: US EPA - Small Drinking Water Systems Handbook
sourceReference: Supporting resource category: Source Water Protection Planning. See SOURCES.md: these are not claim-level verification citations.
optionA: Land use conditions that restrict risky activities in the area
optionB: A larger welcome sign at the subdivision entrance road
optionC: A one time newspaper notice after construction is finished
optionD: Lower water rates for homes built closest to the wells

question: An overall responsible operator plans a two week vacation. What arrangement best maintains compliance coverage?
correctAnswer: Designate a qualified operator in charge and document the handover
explanation: Documented designation of a qualified operator in charge keeps responsibility and compliance coverage continuous during the absence.
options: Leave a note asking staff to call only for major emergencies
Designate a qualified operator in charge and document the handover
Cancel all scheduled sampling until the operator returns
Ask an uncertified volunteer to sign the operating records
sourceTitle: Ontario Regulation 170/03 - Drinking Water Systems
